figurative_meaning_en: To physically assault or beat someone
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে কখনো তার পরিবারের কারো গায়ে হাত তুলবে না।
পুলিশ অভিযোগ করেছে যে, আসামি তার প্রতিবেশীর গায়ে হাত তুলেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He would never raise his hand against his family.
The police accused him of laying hands on his neighbor.
note: This idiom is often used to express disapproval of physical violence, especially in familial or social contexts in Bengali culture.
